book.title: Pwoo ɗe Pool ran nen Afisus Mo

content: Mwaan nƊǝǝn Peeɓang
Kaaɗe wun a jep Naan mo ɗewur wal wun sǝ, ɓe nǝ a tǝng kǝ nwun kám shiimwaan Naan.
Kǝzak, wu mwaan nɗǝǝn wal, kaaɗe Kristi wur wal mmun sǝ, ɓe wur shìn kaashin mbǝ mun kaa zuum kǝ mbiizuum ɗe nǝ kǝ toos shang shang pǝ Naan ɗi.
Taji pwoo nkaa ngaa, kǝ mbii ɗebish mo, kǝ rǝɓet mbii mo pwat nɗǝǝn pwoo fuu mo kas. Mbǝɗe pwoo nkaa kaan kǝ mǝnǝ mo, baa nǝ ret kǝ mo pwat mpwoo nen Naan mo kas.
Kǝsǝ zak, taji mee pwoo ɗebish mǝ le naashweep kǝ pwoo mǝ mwen mo, kǝ pwoo ɗebuu mo, mo pwat nɗǝǝn pwoo fuu mo kas, amma wu yit kǝn plang put pwoo fuu mo.
Taji wu mundǝr nee, nen ɗe moo cìn ngaa, kǝ nen ɗe pan mo a ɗebish, kǝ ngutǝlǝk mo, ɓe baa mee kaan nen mǝnǝ moo mee lǝɓet mǝ sekop nɗǝǝn mulki Kristi kǝ mǝ Naan kas.
Taji wu yit kǝ mee gurum nnum wun shi pwoo ɗebuu mo kas, mbǝɗe a mbǝ mbii mo kaa ɗesǝ mo ɓe tuup Naan nǝ taa nkaa nencii kǝlǝngpee mo.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, taji wu ɓalkaa fuu ashak kǝ nen mǝnǝ mo kas.
Gyet nyam, wun a nɗǝǝn peenkwoo, ɗangɓe yaksǝ wun a nɗǝǝn peeɓang, nɗǝǝn Daa. Nǝ ret kǝ wu mwaan kaa nen ɗe mo nɗǝǝn peeɓang nǝ sǝ.
Ɗak nen ɗe mo nɗǝǝn peeɓang, nǝ a nɗǝǝn mbii ɗeret mo, kǝ ɗe ndǝre mo, kǝ zeen zak.
Wu gung, kǝ nwun kám mbii ɗe mon nret nNaan nyit.
Taji wu lesar fuu mo nɗǝǝn ɗak ɗe mo a mǝ peenkwoo, ɗe baa mo kǝkoop nǝ kas, ɗangɓe nǝ ret kǝ wu woo ɗak mǝnǝ mo agaak.
Nǝ a mbii naashweep mbee satpwoo nkaa mbii ɗe moo cìn mo a sǝsok.
Ɗang katɗang jir mbii ɗe nǝ agaak, a pee ɗe ɓang ɗi, ɓe nǝ nɗee a ɗe gurum mo mak naa nǝ. Mbǝɗe jir mbii ɗe gurum mo mak naa nǝ, ɓe nǝ a nɗǝǝn peeɓang.
Nǝ a kaaɗi mo kǝ ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal nNaan sǝ nǝnee,

content.text: <<Ngusaam, a mii, a yool a peemúut

content: Wu tap kǝ shiimwaan fuu mo. Taji wu mwaan kaa mwen mo sǝ kas, ɗangɓe wu mwaan kaa nen ɗe kǝ seen mo sǝ.
Wu cìn ɗak koo a pee ɗeɗangyi, mbǝɗe teer ɗe yaksǝ nǝ mo gam kǝ mbii ɗebish mo.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe taji wu ɗee a mwen mo kas, amma wu manshii kǝ mbii ɗe Daa wur rǝɓet kǝ nwun cìn.
Taji wu shwaa am anab kǝ nǝ yuur wun kas, mbǝɗe mǝnǝ mak jwaan wun, amma wu ɗee a ɗegǝgam shi Riin Ɗeɓang.
Wu sat mee pwoo kǝ shak shi kook ɗe mǝ kwoop mo, kǝ kook ɗe mo a mǝ Riin. Wu cìn kook ɗeret mo nNaan, kǝ pǝlang nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fuu mo.
Koo pǝranyi ɓe wu plang Naan puun mbǝ mbii mo jir nɗǝǝn sǝm nDaa fun Jesu Kristi.
Mat Mo Kǝ Mish Mo
Wu shin ɗeɗes ndǝr shak, mbǝkǝ wu shin ɗeɗes ɗi nKristi.
Mat mo, wu shin ɗe ɗeɗes mmish fuu mo, kaaɗi wuu cìn nDaa sǝ.
Mbǝɗe mish wur a káa mat, kaaɗi Kristi wur a káa Ekǝlisya sǝ, shii kǝ mǝnǝ a fwooshin fin kǝ wur shikáa fin a Nguɓam war zak.
Kaaɗe Ekǝlisya war ndǝr Kristi, nǝ aasǝ zak, wun mat mo, wu shin ɗeɗes mmish fuu mo nɗǝǝn mbii mo jir.
Mish mo, wu wal mmat fuu mo, kaaɗi Kristi wur wal Ekǝlisya nǝ sǝ, har wur shinkaa shin mbǝ war.
Mbǝkǝ wur le war ɗee ɗi a ɗeɓang shi vwang war kǝ am, kǝ pwoo Naan.
Mbǝkǝ wur ɗak Ekǝlisya nǝ le ɗe nshin, nɗǝǝn ɗeɗes, kǝ ɗemen, baa ashak kǝ mee rap, kǝ mee pee taakat mɓut mo kas. Mbǝkǝ mo ɗee ɗe a ɗeɓang baa kǝ mee rap kas.
Ni ret kǝ mish mo wal mmat fur mo kaa sut sǝ. Ngwe ɗewur wal mmat wur, ɓe wur wal a nshin mǝnǝ.
Baa mee gurum kǝ cam cii shin kas, ɗangɓe wur tap shin mbiise nnǝ, kǝ wur tap kǝ nǝ rǝret, kaaɗi Kristi wur cìn Ekǝlisya sǝ
Mbǝɗe mun a ɓeep mǝ foshik nwur.
A mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe gurum wur nyit puun wur kǝ nǝǝn wur, kǝ wur ɓalkaa ɗe ashak kǝ mat wur, kǝ mo vǝl mo ɗee ɗi a ɗemǝndong.
Ɗesǝ nǝ a mee mbii ɗeɗes ɗesǝsok. Mbii ɗe wen kǝn sat nǝ, a nkaa Kristi kǝ Ekǝlisya.
Jir arang ɓe wu yit koo weyi wur wal mmat wur, kaa kaashin sǝ, kǝ mat war shin ɗeɗes mmish war zak.
